metadata.question: Are more brown/orange areas visible in the Adirondack Mountains on October 8, 2022, than on October 1, 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized over a polygon covering Adirondack Mountains. Two periods: 2022-09-29 to 2022-10-03 (Oct 1 window) and 2022-10-06 to 2022-10-10 (Oct 8 window). If empty, widen by ±5 days; if still empty, fallback to Landsat 8/9 SR with same windows and widened windows.
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds (and cirrus) using S2 QA60; for Landsat, mask cloud, shadow, snow using QA_PIXEL bits. Compute median composite per window.
3. Logic: Compute valid pixel counts at 1 km scale. Define brown/orange mask where R>G (rgi>0.03), NDVI<0.55, and brightness>0.08. Calculate percentage of brown/orange. If collections empty -> C1; if valid pixels 0 -> C2; if any NaN/null -> C3. Compare percentages; if Oct 8 > Oct 1 by >1 percentage point, answer Yes, else No.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.evaluate((v, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err); else resolve(v);
      });
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[-75.1, 43.5], [-73.5, 43.5], [-73.5, 45.1], [-75.1, 45.1], [-75.1, 43.5]]
  ]);
  const scale = 1000;
  const totalPix = await getInfoAsync(
    ee.Image(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('c')
  );

  // 2. Collection builders and masks
  function maskS2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0));
    return img.updateMask(mask)
      .divide(10000)
      .select(['B4','B3','B2','B8'], ['red','green','blue','nir']);
  }
  function s2Col(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end).map(maskS2);
  }
  function maskLandsat(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
    const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
    const snow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0);
    const mask = cloud.or(shadow).or(snow).not();
    const scaled = img.select(['SR_B4','SR_B3','SR_B2','SR_B5'], ['red','green','blue','nir'])
      .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return scaled.updateMask(mask);
  }
  function lsCol(start, end) {
    const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end);
    const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end);
    return l8.merge(l9).map(maskLandsat);
  }
  function brownMaskFrom(img) {
    const eps = ee.Number(1e-6);
    const r = img.select('red'), g = img.select('green'), b = img.select('blue'), n = img.select('nir');
    const rgi = r.subtract(g).divide(r.add(g).add(eps));
    const ndvi = n.subtract(r).divide(n.add(r).add(eps));
    const brightness = r.add(g).add(b).divide(3);
    const brown = rgi.gt(0.03).and(ndvi.lt(0.55)).and(brightness.gt(0.08));
    return brown.updateMask(img.select('red').mask());
  }
  async function getPeriodStats(label, start, end) {
    // Try S2 base
    let src = 'S2';
    let col = s2Col(start, end);
    let n = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (n === 0) {
      // widen window
      const widenStart = ee.Date(start).advance(-5, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd');
      const widenEnd = ee.Date(end).advance(5, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd');
      const ws = await getInfoAsync(widenStart);
      const we = await getInfoAsync(widenEnd);
      col = s2Col(ws, we);
      n = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (n === 0) {
        // fallback Landsat
        src = 'LS';
        col = lsCol(start, end);
        n = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (n === 0) {
          const colW = lsCol(ws, we);
          n = await getInfoAsync(colW.size());
          if (n === 0) return {status:'C1'};
          col = colW;
        }
      }
    }
    const img = col.median().clip(roi);
    const validPix = await getInfoAsync(
      img.select('red').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('red')
    );
    if (!validPix || validPix === 0) {
      return {status:'C2', src, n};
    }
    const brownMask = brownMaskFrom(img).selfMask().rename('brown');
    const brownPix = await getInfoAsync(
      brownMask.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('brown')
    );
    const cloudPct = 100 * (1 - validPix / totalPix);
    const brownPct = 100 * (brownPix / validPix);
    if ([cloudPct, brownPct].some(v => v === null || isNaN(v) || !isFinite(v) || v < 0 || v > 100)) {
      return {status:'C3', src, n};
    }
    return {status:'OK', src, n, validPix, cloudPct, brownPct};
  }

  // 3. Periods
  const p1 = await getPeriodStats('Oct1', '2022-09-29', '2022-10-03');
  const p2 = await getPeriodStats('Oct8', '2022-10-06', '2022-10-10');

  // 4. Output and Decision
  console.log(`Region pixels (1km): ${totalPix}`);
  if (p1.status !== 'OK' || p2.status !== 'OK') {
    if (p1.status === 'C1' || p2.status === 'C1') {
      console.log(`Oct1 status: ${p1.status || 'OK'}, Oct8 status: ${p2.status || 'OK'}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (p1.status === 'C2' || p2.status === 'C2') {
      console.log(`Oct1 status: ${p1.status || 'OK'}, Oct8 status: ${p2.status || 'OK'}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (p1.status === 'C3' || p2.status === 'C3') {
      console.log(`Oct1 status: ${p1.status || 'OK'}, Oct8 status: ${p2.status || 'OK'}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
  }
  console.log(`Oct1 (${p1.src}) imgs:${p1.n}, valid:${p1.validPix}, cloud%:${p1.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
  console.log(`Oct1 brown%:${p1.brownPct.toFixed(1)}`);
  console.log(`Oct8 (${p2.src}) imgs:${p2.n}, valid:${p2.validPix}, cloud%:${p2.cloudPct.toFixed(1)}`);
  console.log(`Oct8 brown%:${p2.brownPct.toFixed(1)}`);
  const delta = p2.brownPct - p1.brownPct;
  console.log(`Change (pp): ${delta.toFixed(1)}`);
  if (!isFinite(delta)) {
    console.log('C3');
  } else if (delta > 1.0) {
    console.log('A');
  } else {
    console.log('B');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  try {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
    });
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
    });
    await runAnalysis();
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

initEE();
```
